stage1.impression: A dark back-bar of bottles on shelves lit by thin edge strips that read as LED display lighting, with a frosted pendant on the right and a timber counter in the foreground. The speaker in the central niche shows only as a ghostly grey blur behind frosted glass: a rounded outline, a dark smudge and a white woofer cut off by the counter. Concrete, steel and fir are mostly lost in murk, the glass reads as a black cube, and the soft, smeared surfaces say render, not photograph.

blocking_9: The speaker reads at a glance as the hero: clear acrylic edges catching light, the white batts and horn legible, not a silhouette smeared against a glowing back
The shelves' lit edges read as polished thick acrylic edges glowing softly, not white LED strips (row p95 near 227)
Board-formed concrete, blackened steel and fir grain show at 1:1 (formwork lines, tie holes, patina) in the back-bar, which is now a flat brown at median 22
Pools of light from the pendants on the fir counter, with visible falloff; the counter is flat now (p95 45)
A real, recognisable prop of life near camera (a rocks glass with whisky and ice, a coaster), not a black cube
No denoiser smear or soft CG surfaces at full delivered resolution

defects.what: The speaker's upper cabinet reads as a dark smudge and an outline behind a grey frosted back; the horn and acrylic can't be read, and the denoiser has smeared it
The woofer and white batt are cropped by the counter edge, and a steel crossbar cuts the speaker in two at y about 340
The shelf edges glow as thin white LED strips (p95 227) and look like retail display lighting
The right shelves' edge strips are the same: thin bright lines with a hard cutoff
The concrete back wall is a flat dark brown (median 22) with no formwork texture; the bottles are generic and repeat (the same labelled bottle many times)
The near glass reads as an opaque black cube with a white specular, not a glass
The fir counter is flat-lit (median 31, p95 45): no pendant pool, and its front edge is a dark band
The pendant's frosted tube is near clipping (2 % clipped) and shows a square hot spot at its top, so it reads as a CG emitter
The ceiling beams are smooth brown, with no checks or end grain
The right wall/door is a flat featureless dark panel

changes.problem: The speaker is backlit by its niche's frosted back, so it reads as a grey silhouette instead of a lit clear-acrylic object.

evidence.measured: median 56, p95 127, RGB 66/54/46; the outline and horn are low-contrast against the back; the white batts below (340,345,415,410) are at median 101

change.setting: niches' frosted backs emission; niche spots
change.from: frosted back 0.35; 2 x spot 160 W, 2600 K, cone 30 deg
change.to: frosted back 0.12; spots 220 W, cone 20 deg, aimed down the front faces and edges of the cabinet from above-front so the polished acrylic edges and the horn throat catch highlights

changes.expected: The cabinet's edges and horn read as bright lines and forms against a darker back, and the speaker becomes the brightest object after the pendant.

changes.problem: The shelves' lit edges are thin hot lines that read as LED retail strips.

evidence.measured: p95 227 against a median of 22, a 1-2 px bright line with a hard edge

change.to: 1.0, and make the shelf edge the visible polished face of 25-30 mm acrylic so the glow spreads up the bottles

changes.expected: The shelf edges glow amber-white, not white; the bottles above each shelf get a soft uplight.

changes.problem: The pendants make no pool on the fir counter, so the bar is flat and the near foreground dead.

change.to: 180 W, cone 24 deg, aimed straight down onto the counter; the pendant's frosted tubes stay at 0.35

changes.expected: Distinct warm ovals on the counter, falling off to dark between them, with the fir grain readable inside the pools.

changes.problem: The frame sits at the very bottom of the dim-but-readable band, so the concrete, steel and bottles go to mud.

evidence.measured: frame median 24.6; 85 % of pixels below 40; back-bar left median 22

change.to: 1.45 (with c2 lowering the strips, so the highlights hold)

changes.expected: Frame median about 32-38; the bottles' labels and the concrete read without lifting the blacks.

changes.problem: The back-bar's concrete and the beams are smooth, untextured brown, so they read as CG, not board-formed concrete or old fir.

evidence.measured: median 22, RGB 32/20/12; no formwork lines or tie holes visible at 2x crop

change.setting: concrete's tone and sheen; fir stain
change.to: a lighter warm grey concrete (albedo about 0.35) with 150 mm board-mark bump, tie holes and faint staining, roughness 0.8; the beams get checks and darker end grain

changes.expected: The wall between the shelves shows horizontal board lines catching the shelves' uplight; the wall reads as concrete.

changes.problem: The near glass reads as a black cube, and the bottles repeat one model, so there is no believable sign of life.

evidence.measured: crush 0.86 %, p5 4.8: an opaque black body with one white specular

change.from: an opaque cube glass; the same bottle repeated
change.to: a heavy clear rocks glass with an inch of whisky and one large ice cube on a felt coaster, a folded menu beside it; at least 6 distinct bottle shapes and label colours, all muted

changes.expected: The glass shows refraction of the counter and an amber glint; the shelves read as a stocked bar.

changes.problem: The counter edge crops the speaker's woofer, and a steel crossbar splits it, so the hero is not read whole.

evidence.measured: the woofer is cut at y about 410 by the counter; the crossbar at y about 340

change.to: z 1.45, a step closer (x 7.6) and 35 mm, centred on the niche so the whole cabinet clears the counter and sits on the left third line

changes.expected: The whole speaker is in frame above the counter, larger, at about 25 % of the frame height or more.

changes.problem: The pendant's frosted tube clips and shows a square hot spot, and the denoiser smears the frosted and clear surfaces.

evidence.measured: median 193, clip 2.03 %, a square bright patch near the top; smear visible in the speaker crop

change.to: lamps 2.5 with a diffuser so the tube glows evenly; 512 samples, adaptive 0.01, denoiser prefilter accurate with albedo and normal passes

changes.expected: The tube glows evenly with no square, and the speaker's edges stay crisp.

out_of_scope.request: Give the hero speaker a saturated tint so the frame has its one colour
out_of_scope.why: The card fixes this niche's pair as Fog (water-clear). The 'one colour from the speaker' test can't be met in this frame without changing the product; the owner would have to put an Ember speaker in view instead.

out_of_scope.request: Remove the steel crossbar in the niche that splits the speaker
out_of_scope.why: The niche and back-bar are fixed room design; only the camera (c7) can work around it.
